intro.sr: Administrator može da premesti termin na drugog zaposlenog. Sistem sam filtrira listu - zaposleni koji je već zauzet u tom terminu se uopšte ne pojavljuje kao opcija, umesto da se ponudi pa odbije. Snimljeno na telefonu (390x844).
intro.en: An admin can move an appointment to a different employee. The system filters the list itself - an employee already busy at that time simply doesn't appear as an option, instead of being offered and then rejected. Recorded on a phone (390x844).
